data.name: Pinterest-native creative v8 daily outbound test
data.objective: Forward-test one current verified enriched catalog product with a product-specific editorial use reveal and a unique canonical tracked destination.
data.hypothesis: Showing the exact mouth-held tongue cat brush in a composed cat-spa ritual will create a calm-first, absurd-second double take and a credible reason to click through to the exact product.
successCriteria: Compare two genuinely distinct executions and advance no more than one survivor.
The survivor passes every hard gate, averages at least 4.0, has no score below 3, and preserves the product's rigid mouth tray, tongue flap, peg rows, scale, and function.
Any public write uses Pinterest production API v5 on the goosegifts BUSINESS account with unique tracking, durable receipt, and readback.
constraints: Maximum three image-generation calls, one diagnosed revision, and one survivor.
Never spend, use Sandbox, or treat Pinterest v3 as traffic evidence.
One public Pin maximum for 2026-09-01 under the standing scheduled-studio authorization and Cameron's explicit approval.
